_README: RECORDED EVIDENCE for offline mode (CHRONOS_OFFLINE_DEMO=1) and for CI.
What this file is: synthetic search results, written by hand, that let the
whole verification path — extraction, judging, scoring, eviction — run with
no Tavily key and no network. The SCORES produced from it are computed by
the real scoring code in chronos/score.py. The EVIDENCE is not real: these
are not actual pages and the URLs are illustrative.
A deliberate constraint on how it is written: each entry asserts only that
the claim it matches is OUT OF DATE, and points at where the current value
lives. It does not invent a specific replacement figure. That keeps the
fixtures from quietly becoming a second source of stale facts, and it is
why `current_value` reads like 'see the live quote' rather than a number.
`published_date` may be written as 'T-3', meaning three days before now, so
the recency term stays meaningful however long after writing this is run.
With a TAVILY_API_KEY and CHRONOS_OFFLINE_DEMO=0, none of this is used.

results.raw_content: Download Python. The current stable release is listed at the top of this page. Python ships a new feature release every October under PEP 602, so 3.11 (released October 2022) is several feature releases behind the current version. Each release is supported for five years, and 3.11 has moved from active bugfix support into security-only maintenance.

The Regulation was adopted, published in the Official Journal of the European Union, and entered into force in August 2024. Its obligations apply on a staged timetable rather than all at once. Statements describing the Act as a proposal still under trilogue negotiation, with no agreed text and no application dates, are out of date.
